name: Airbnb Scraper
description: Airbnb scraper for Python and the command line: stays for a city, region or neighbourhood with nightly price, stay total, rating, reviews, bedrooms, beds and map point, for the dates you choose, as JSON or CSV. Free and open source; sign in with your QuanticData account, no proxies or headless browser to run.

commands.name: search
commands.help: Airbnb stays for a city, region or neighbourhood
commands.description: Airbnb stay search for a place — title, type, nightly price, rating, reviews, beds and coordinates.

inputs.name: location
inputs.description: City, region or neighbourhood, e.g. "Rome", "Rome, Italy" or "Brooklyn, New York". Resolved by Airbnb's own search, exactly as typing it into the site would.

inputs.name: checkin
inputs.description: Arrival date as YYYY-MM-DD. Must be given together with checkout; omit both to let Airbnb price each listing for its own suggested stay.

inputs.name: checkout
inputs.description: Departure date as YYYY-MM-DD. Must be after checkin.

inputs.name: adults
inputs.description: Number of adult guests (1–16). Omit for Airbnb's default of one.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the search from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...). Airbnb prices in that country's currency.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many stays to deliver at most (1–90). You pay only for delivered stays.
